name: Conqueror
description: Units with this ability can capture villages.

name: Fighter of the Water
description: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in water.

name: Fighter of the Forest
description: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in forest.

name: Fighter of the Mountain
description: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in mountain.

name: Destroyer
description: Units with this ability can destroy villages.

name: Air Force
description: Units with this ability can move through all terrains using 1 movement point, and can move through ground enemy units. But they will not receive defence bonuses from terrains.

name: Necromancer
description: Necromancers can summon skeletons from fallen units, at the same time they will not be [Poisoned] if they standby on tombstones.

name: Healer
description: Units with this ability can heal allies, and the healing amount will increase when leveling up. Note that healer's heal can exceed target's HP cap once.

name: Charger
description: For units who have this ability, once they finished their actions they can use their remaining movement points to move again.

name: Poisoner
description: For units who have this ability, their attacks will attach [Poisoned] status to enemies for 2 turns. However units with this ability will not affect each other.

name: Repairer
description: Units with this ability can repair ruined villages.

name: Undead
description: For units who have this ability, tombstones will not appear on the map when they die. Moreover, when they are [Poisoned] they can still receive heals from terrains and the poison damages will become heals. However heals from allies will become damages to them.

name: Marksman
description: For units who have this ability, they gain 15 attack bonus when attacking enemies with ability [Air Force].

name: Son of the Water
description: Units with this ability can move through water terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are on water they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.

name: Son of the Forest
description: Units with this ability can move through forest terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are in forest they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.

name: Son of the Mountain
description: Units with this ability can move through mountain terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are in mountain they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.

name: Fleet-footed
description: Units with this ability can move through land terrains using 1 movement point.

name: Slowing Aura
description: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will attach [Slowed] status to enemies within 2 blocks for 1 turn. However units with this ability will not affect each other.

name: Commander
description: Units with this ability can capture castles.

name: Heavy Machine
description: Units with this ability cannot take action when moved and status cannot be attached to them.

name: Attack Aura
description: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will attach [Inspired] status to allies within 2 blocks for current turn.

name: Bloodthirsty
description: For units who have this ability, each enemy within 2 blocks will give 10 attack bonus and 5 physical defence bonus to them, but they cannot receive heals from terrains.

name: Guardian
description: For units who have this ability, when on ally villages or castles, they will gain 5 defence bonus.

name: Refresh Aura
description: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will clear debuff of allies within 2 blocks and heal them a bit. The healing amount will increase when leveling up.

name: Lord of Terror
description: For units who have this ability, their melee attacks will be 1.5 times stronger.

name: Counter Madness
description: For units who have this ability, if the attacker is within 2 blocks away they can perform counter attacks.

name: Blinding Attack
description: For units who have this ability, their attacks will attach [Blinded] status to enemies. However units with this ability will not affect each other.

name: Rehabilitation
description: Units with this ability will recover 25% max HP at turn start, regardless of being [Poisoned] or not.

name: Absorptive Skin
description: For units who have this ability, they receive 50% less damage from ranged attacks.
